notes: Context-creation requestSizes opt-in; immediate immutable seven-field native-byte snapshot with Option counts. Original retained instance and live owners required; no terminal wait. Chromium supplies total and decoded bytes, Firefox received headers/encoded entity/total and HTTP/1.1 transferred-body difference, stock WebKit sent request and received response metrics including decoded bytes. Firefox decoded, Chromium request/header/body split, WebKit encoded entity and ambiguous cache/redirect/worker counts remain unavailable. No estimates, body downloads or implicit collection; partial numeric coverage is deliberate.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Optional browser features do work only when requested, within the owning context or operation.
